_comment: Copy to config.json and edit for your booth. Nothing secret belongs in git; secrets go in .env (see .env.example).

build._comment: shapeSizes are the backing bounding boxes in mm; kept modest so prints stay under the 15-min budget. customMax bounds the free-draw shape.
build._outline_comment: Freehand custom-shape healing. outlineCloseMm bridges the gap where the loop didn't quite close; outlineOpenMm deletes spikes/needles thinner than about twice this; outlineSmooth is Chaikin smoothing passes.

colourChange._comment: Inserted at the backing->design transition. M400 U1 is the Bambu A1 pause: it finishes moves and pauses so the operator uses the printer screen's filament menu to unload colour 1 / load colour 2, then Resume.
gcode: M400 U1 ; ===== COLOUR CHANGE: unload colour 1, load colour 2 on the printer screen, then Resume =====

template._comment: Replace start.gcode / end.gcode with the header+footer from a REAL sliced A1 mini file for your filament, so bed levelling / flow calibration run correctly. Placeholders {nozzle} {bed} {nozzleFirst} {bedFirst} are substituted.

notify._comment: Who sends the WhatsApp: 'ghl' (GoHighLevel inbound webhook — recommended, GHL owns the message + nurture), 'meta' (direct WhatsApp Cloud API, see whatsapp block), or 'none'.

ghl._comment: Inbound-webhook URLs go in .env (GHL_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL / GHL_READY_WEBHOOK_URL) or here. One URL is fine — branch on payload.event in the GHL workflow.

lan._comment: Bambu LAN-mode auto-send + status monitoring. Turn LAN Mode ON on each printer (Settings > Network) and copy its Access Code + Serial below. Verify with: npm run test-printer
